title: Crash on startup after upgrading to 2.3.1
body:
After upgrading weathercli to version 2.3.1 the program crashes on startup with KeyError: 'api_key'.

Steps to reproduce:
1. run `weathercli now`
2. crash happens immediately

Expected: shows the current forecast.
Actual: traceback with KeyError 'api_key' while reading config.yaml.

Environment: Ubuntu 22.04, Python 3.11, weathercli 2.3.1.

title: weathercli crashes immediately at startup (KeyError api_key)
body: Since updating to version 2.3.1, weathercli crashes on startup. The traceback shows KeyError: 'api_key' while reading config.yaml. I expected the current forecast, but instead got a crash. Running Ubuntu 22.04 with Python 3.11.

title: Startup crash, KeyError in config.yaml after update
body: weathercli 2.3.1 crashes at startup with KeyError: 'api_key' coming from config.yaml parsing right after the update. Expected the forecast output, actual result is a traceback. Ubuntu 22.04, Python 3.11.

title: CSV export is extremely slow for large city lists
body: Exporting 5000 rows of history to CSV takes over 10 minutes on my machine. I expected the export to finish in seconds, but instead it crawls. Using version 2.3.0 on Windows 11. Looks like a performance problem, maybe memory usage grows without bound.

title: CSV export writes columns in the wrong order
body:
When exporting history to CSV, the date and temperature columns are swapped.

Steps to reproduce:
1. run `weathercli history --csv out.csv`
2. open out.csv

Expected: date column first.
Actual: temperature column first.

Environment: macOS 14, weathercli 2.3.1.

title: Feature request: support hourly forecasts
body: It would be nice if the forecast command could show hourly data, not just daily. Please add support for an --hourly flag.

title: README typo in the installation section
body: The README installation section says `pip install weathercl` but the package is named `weathercli`. Small documentation typo in the docs.

title: How do I configure an HTTP proxy?
body: Question: how can I route requests through a corporate HTTP proxy? Is it possible to set proxy environment variables, or is there a config option?

title: App crashes when I click the radar button
body: It just crashes. Please fix this bug.

title: ValueError when fetching radar data
body: I get a ValueError when running the radar command on version 2.2.0 (Windows 11). Expected a radar image to be downloaded.

title: Units switch ignored in config file
body:
Bug: setting units = metric in config.yaml is ignored.

Steps to reproduce:
1. set units = metric in config.yaml
2. run `weathercli now`

Expected: temperatures in Celsius.
Actual: temperatures in Fahrenheit.

Environment: Fedora 40, Python 3.12, version 2.3.1.

title: Old crash on startup (fixed in 2.3.0)
body: This was an old startup crash with KeyError 'api_key' in config.yaml on version 2.2.0, fixed already. Ubuntu 22.04, Python 3.11. Expected forecast, actual traceback.
